overview: A Movie By Mubarek Yasin

title: Stray Kids LIVE at Rock in Rio 2026
overview: THE MAIN STAGE IS ABOUT TO SHAKE.  ...  Making history as the first K-pop headliner to take over the legendary Main Stage at Rock in Rio, the self-producing powerhouse group brings an explosive 2-hour stadium spectacle. Backed by a full live rock band, heavy pyrotechnics, and relentless choreography, the octet blends deafening sub-bass, industrial hip-hop, and metal-infused arrangements into an intense, high-energy festival set designed to shatter crowd limits.

title: Morten
overview: A coming-of-age tale told in a magical-realism style about a teenage boy, Morten, who feels out of place among his wealthier classmates. While they enjoy expensive school trips, he spends his days in his family’s dilapidated farmhouse, finding solace only in a camera gifted by his grandfather, a lens through which the world seems brighter. When two girls enter his life - Miia, a street artist, and Emilie, a mysterious girl from the marsh - Morten’s world is turned upside down as he struggles to understand both his first stirrings of love and the changing world around him.

title: Gator Face
overview: A Florida vacation becomes a blood-soaked fight for survival when a group of friends are hunted through the swamps by a savage cult that feeds its victims to ravenous alligators in the name of an ancient reptilian god.

title: The Berm
overview: Yauguiha Mohamed Embarec, a young Sahrawi refugee, leads a team clearing landmines along the military barrier that divides Western Sahara. The documentary follows her work and the daily lives of women living with the lasting consequences of displacement and conflict.

title: Pradhama Drishtiya Kuttakkar
overview: Follows a woman constable who joins the police force through appointment after the death of her husband.

title: Ain't No Sunshine
overview: It all started with a girl, the rat king who took her, and three outlaws who are going to try to get her back. In the wild western wasteland, there's gonna be hell to pay.

title: Tickets, Please.
overview: On her daily commute to work, an aspiring entrepreneur has recurring visions of a man finding a duffel bag full of cash. But when she encounters strange people who suddenly become rich in unexpected ways, her reality begins to unravel as she struggles with the unseen powers which determine fate and fortune.

title: Mindflip
overview: Marilyn Hardesty is an aging horror film actress, and heiress to her ancient husband's biotech fortune through a whirlwind courtship, marriage, and funeral. Terminally ill, she is determined to cheat death and rekindle her career by transferring her mind into the body of a younger woman. With Norman Baetz, her "personal assistant", she recruits Dr. Laurence Fine, a brilliant, twisted neurobiologist, to serve her obsession with immortality. With the promise of Reality TV stardom, they lure three young women to Marilyn's remote estate. Ulterior motives unfold. Early experiments prowl the estate. The young women reach a grim realization: escape is the only means of survival. Can they evade Dr. Fine's cut and paste cybernetics? Will Marilyn achieve eternal life or drown in the fountain of youth?

title: Singh vs Kaur 2
overview: Singh vs Kaur 2 is an upcoming Indian Punjabi-language romantic comedy film directed by Navaniat Singh and produced by Gippy Grewal's Humble Motion Pictures and SVF Entertainment. Serving as a standalone sequel to the 2013 film Singh vs Kaur, it stars Gippy Grewal and Shehnaaz Gill, scheduled for worldwide release on 11 September 2026.

title: The Last Screening
overview: On the night before the full-scale invasion, an old movie theater in Kyiv becomes a refuge for two strangers—Luka, a projectionist, and Varya, a mysterious girl. As alarming news comes in from all sides, they try to escape reality amid the illusions and light of the movie screen. But can cinema stop time?

title: Closure
overview: After his teenage son goes missing, Daniel scours the depths of the Vistula River, torn between the dread of a fatal leap and the hope that his son may still be alive.

title: Behind The Sins
overview: A director wanted to produce a fiction film about mining issues with local citizens, but because the story did not match reality, the local citizens decided to go home

title: Mighty Mary
overview: Mighty Mary chronicles an amazing group of “we eat nails for breakfast” type of women: the first all-women’s sailing team to contend for the famed America’s Cup, the holy grail for one of sport’s most elite and exclusive racing events.  This team was groundbreaking, beginning with an advertisement in the New York Times.  From there, a group of world class and Olympic sailors as well as Olympic rowers came together, a team which included a deaf sailor, a Native Hawaiian sailor, and the first African American sailor to ever win an America’s Cup race (as a coach of this novice, erstwhile team).  What was dismissed as a publicity stunt turned into something unimaginable. This motley crew (sailing aboard Mighty Mary) stunningly eliminated Stars & Stripes from contention. However, a secret backroom deal the night before the race upended that result. This is a true underdog story about a team which reshaped what could be possible in a sport that had long been inaccessible.

title: The Remotes
overview: A grieving detective finds himself increasingly ensnared while investigating a case involving a sinister navigation app causing physical and psychological debris.

title: In Alaska
overview: After accidentally shooting at the TransAlaska Pipeline, Woody, a 17-year old Inuit, becomes the target of a terrorist manhunt. The chase through wilderness is led by veteran FBI agent Susan Tarheel, torn between doing her job and her empathy for the young man…

title: The Company
overview: A precision crew assembles for one last job, but the score isn't what anyone thinks it is.

title: Lena Situations - Celui où ils disent au revoir
Drifter
overview: In a forgotten desert town, a solitary racetrack janitor with a gift for drifting is haunted by his tragic past. Given a single chance to compete at a pro drifting event, he discovers his raw talent is useless without the one thing he's always avoided: connection with others. Under a hardened mentor, he must learn to trust his found family and transform his untamed, lonely art into a dangerous dance of partnership, or be consumed and controlled by the past he's desperate to escape.

title: Chicken Scratch
overview: A gambling addict on the eve of eviction in NYC must embark on a wealthy stranger's quest to retrieve a plate of legendary chicken wings in exchange for his rent money.

title: Betty
overview: A young woman is haunted by the dead lady in her tub.

title: Falling into Place
overview: Kaia returns home for her town's fall festival as well as her high school reunion and spends the week with her childhood best friend, James, to complete their unfinished fall bucket list.

title: Closing Night
overview: A celebrated actress's life begins to unravel on the eve of her greatest performance. When her sister April arrives in New York after a 30-year estrangement, the stage is set for a tense family confrontation.

title: Whatcha Want
overview: When a young trophy wife and recent immigrant from Hong Kong uncovers her wealthy husband's betrayal, she reignites her passion for dance, forcing her to choose between the life she was given and the liberation she longs for.

title: Calçada Perra
overview: A girl walks through various spaces searching for her memory through a single possession, a Polaroid picture she finds in her pockets. During her journey, she asks for help from several people who exhibit atypical behavior.

title: Vintage Violence
overview: When a disgraced livestreamer discovers a trove of rare vintage denim in a Colorado mine, he follows it to Tokyo and straight into the arms of a woman who may be using him. Caught between desire and betrayal, he soon finds himself entangled in black-market turf wars, yakuza, and a past that refuses to stay buried.

title: Spectrum is 20: The Death and Life of New Captain Scarlet
overview: Featuring new interviews with key cast and crew, and drawing on a wealth of unseen archive materials, this comprehensive retrospective explores the genesis, production and legacy of the series like never before.

title: Dough Man
overview: When a quirky newcomer moves in, the eldest of three sisters, Evelyn, becomes convinced he’s a witch. Her middle sister dismisses it, the youngest falls for him, and Evelyn descends into a string of increasingly absurd attempts to prove her theory, ending with one final test.

title: Skavlan & Sverige - uppesittarkväll
overview: An election-eve special with *Skavlan & Sverige* – in an extended format. Guests from diverse worlds – and a host with no right to vote.

title: Némesis
overview: When four friends are bored at home, they decide to go up to the attic to find something to entertain themselves. While searching, they discover a mysterious VHS tape labeled “NÉMESIS. DO NOT OPEN.”

title: Soul Catcher
overview: Follows a gender-fluid Ts'msyen youth tasked with retrieving the soul of their great-grandfather's totem pole in this fluid, evocative animation about reclaiming history and righting the wrongs of a dark colonial past.

title: Não Era Óbvio
overview: During an afternoon of gaming, Miguel deals with the frustrations of not knowing whether his crush is reciprocated.

title: BLINDSPOT
overview: After introverted Nichole Wallace encounters someone who should be dead, her trust in the people and world around her is pushed to its absolute limit.

title: 77 Hours
overview: 77 Hours is a psychological thriller and political drama set across the nights of January 8 and 9, when Iran's streets become the scene of one of the darkest and bloodiest crackdowns in recent memory.  Unarmed and unprepared, ordinary people are trapped in chaos, gunfire, fear, and death. At the center is a man who is not a hero prepared for battle, but an ordinary person forced to survive in an inhuman catastrophe — surrounded by wounded civilians, security forces, and collapsing memories.  Through a tense, intimate narrative moving between streets, hospital corridors, hidden spaces, and broken recollections, the film explores survival, sacrifice, guilt, silence, and the fragile line between truth and fear.

title: Kick On
overview: When a night of partying leads four friends to kick on, at the extravagant drug-fueled lair of a mobster's reckless son, they find themselves fighting for their lives amidst a brutal spiral of paranoia, violence and ultimate betrayal.

title: 2:LOVE
overview: A major tennis tournament is about to begin, and the tension is palpable. On the court, two ball girls crouch on either side of the net. Each believes her moment has arrived. They want to be the best ball girls in the tournament's history. The ultimate ball girl championship.  But when the match begins and the girls look into each other's eyes, they are surprised to discover another force beyond the net: attraction. A dynamic that begins as bitter rivalry transforms into a magnetic passion, during which the girls search for a way to escape the competition that stands in the way of their love.

title: Bahasa Cinta Yang Beda
overview: The married life of Cinta and Rangga, where their relationship begins to feel stagnant due to routine and unrecognized differences in their love languages.

title: Strong Son
overview: A former South Asian bodybuilder moves back in with his aging father to become his primary caregiver, forcing him to balance the physical strength that once defined him with the mental and emotional challenges of caring for the man who raised him.

title: Svenska nyheter valspecial
overview: Messiah Hallberg recaps the election and presents a gripping report from the Liberals' election night party.

title: After Impact
overview: After losing his father, Ethan Nichols inherits one of the largest greenhouses in the country, just as the world faces a devastating threat from an approaching asteroid. As society begins to unravel, Ethan grapples with personal betrayal, overwhelming loneliness, and the growing fear that survival may come at the cost of his humanity. Seeking refuge in his family’s bunker, Ethan endures the harsh aftermath of the impact, wrestling with physical injury and emotional despair. When a faint voice crackles over his radio, Ethan discovers he's not as alone as he believed.

title: The Last Kiss
overview: Laurel always imagined her first kiss would be a fairy tale. Instead, that fantasy turns frightening when she's cursed with an ability to see the death of anyone she kisses. After a vision reveals her crush is doomed to die in a strange murder spree targeting her closest friends, she races to unmask the killer before the mystery becomes a massacre.

title: Run Hide Fight: Infidels
overview: When radical Islamist terrorists hijack a liberal college's pro-Palestine encampment, a ragtag band of red-blooded students, a security guard, and a Delta Force vet must arm up to save their clueless peers.

title: Hyper Misao Produce ~HYPE!4~
overview: Chika Nanase trains by herself during a night at the Kanda Myōjin shrine in Tokyo, and after finishing her prayer, she finds Hyper Misao's mask on the ground in front of her. Next thing she knows, she is pulled into another world - instead of Kanda Myōjin, Nanase is now in a realm called Can Do Myōjin! Surprisingly emotional shenanigans ensue.

title: 70 Up
overview: Across seven decades, British viewers watched 14 children grow into adults in films broadcast every seven years. In the series' final installment – with all surviving participants now in their seventies – what do their lives tell us about Britain?

title: Building
overview: Set during the construction of the World Trade Center in 1970s New York. After a co-worker starts spreading false rumors about him and the boss' daughter, an electrician retaliates with an escalating series of anonymous prank notes. The notes spread as gossip through the crew, sparking a psychological war of rumors and retaliation amid the daily grind of construction work.

title: Heart of Stone
overview: Following the death of his parents, an estranged son seeks forgiveness for a mortal sin–only to draw the short end of the stick.

title: Pinoy Sexy Classics: Mga Pelikulang Nagpalaki Sa'yo
overview: Revisit the scenes that captivated a generation, featuring Rosanna Roces, Amanda Page, Sunshine Cruz, and other stars in unforgettable moments that made them famous, hosted by the alluring VMX siren, Jamilla Obispo. Relive the passion that ignites an era.

title: Resident Evil
overview: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

title: The Weight
overview: When Samuel is torn from his daughter and sent to a brutal prison, Warden Clancy offers him a high-stakes proposition: smuggle gold out of a remote mine with a dangerous crew of prisoners and he’ll win his freedom.

title: Mammalia
overview: Antonia (45) and Mavra (27) live together in a house with domesticated animals. Beneath fragile routines, a struggle for dominance unfolds. As care turns into control, their relationship escalates into a disturbing power game that blurs the boundaries between protection, exploitation and violence. What are we? Humans? Or Animals? Or Savages?

title: The Intern
overview: A story about what happens when  Seon-wu, the CEO of a fashion company who is more passionate than anyone when it comes to work, hires Ki-ho, who has a wealth of life experience, as a silver intern.

title: Seven letters
overview: Set in the early 2000s in Argentina, Augusto lives alone and spends his time watching TV and calling random people on the phone asking for help with his crosswords. His world turns upside down and he falls into a swirl of paranoia when his sister starts calling to talk about their mother.

title: The Artists
overview: In a cold warehouse, two criminals debate their careers future over the rise of AI.

title: Drop Dead
overview: A group of strangers board a freight elevator and find themselves trapped in an ever-worsening life-and-death predicament that ultimately reveals they are all linked together in a sinister, supernatural, or even biblical nightmare.

title: Think Good
overview: When Gil meets Jacques, their love seems irresistible. And when she unexpectedly falls pregnant, he convinces her to start a family. However, their hasty marriage reveals that she is not as deeply rooted into the Jewish faith as he is. Jacques reassures her: "Think good and it will be good". Little by little, Gil realizes the insidious control he exerts over her life...

title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
overview: On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go wrong when a wild beast appears in the woods.

title: Gentle Monster
overview: After relocating with her family to the countryside, a renowned pianist uncovers a life-shattering truth that forces her to confront the complexities of love, trust, and deception.

title: Land of Wonders
overview: Young artist Philip unexpectedly finds himself in a true Land of Wonders—a secret, magical world hidden in the vast expanses of Siberia. A thrilling adventure awaits him, meeting the fantastical Imor people and their amazing animals. But due to human intervention, the Land of Wonders and its inhabitants are in danger of destruction. Philip must save this magical world and his new friends at any cost.

title: Captain Newfoundland
overview: Media mogul, athlete, creator of the psychedelic superhero Captain Newfoundland, and an activist against his home province joining Confederation: Geoff Stirling was all these things and more. To do justice to a character as complex as this film’s protagonist, Mike Feehan turns the camera on himself and his co-director Jamie Miller as they weave together archival footage, animation, and fantastical recreations from Stirling's experimental 1970s late-night TV show, all very in keeping with NTV's original broadcast mission. Captain Newfoundland is an illuminating and wildly entertaining portrait of a complex man and his impact on the province that, according to Stirling, may or may not be the tip of the long-lost island of Atlantis.

title: Henry's First Dates
overview: Lucy, a woman who's living her first date on repeat with Henry, a good-natured, animal-loving guy with a bizarre condition: every time he wakes up, he can't remember anything from the day before.

title: 10éjszakás kaland
overview: Instead of ten commandments, ten intertwined Tinder dates: virtual relationships, bleak joys, fast-paced moves, spiritual deviance, hypocritical hypocrisy, perverse homophobia, lustful bloody revenge, and in the background a surprising twist that is far from being about joys...  This boundary-pushing independent film is not a traditional romantic story, but an experimental, provocative look at the 2020s, where the search for happiness is often just a swipe right away, yet it seems unattainable.

title: Last Train to Fortune
overview: When schoolteacher Cecil Peachtree misses the last train to Fortune, he strikes a deal with outlaw Dooley to secure safe and timely travel.  On the journey, the two develop an odd friendship through the power of knowledge.

title: Bleeding Hearts
overview: A music-driven love story about real-life couple Zella Day and Jesse Woods, the musicians behind the emerging band Chaparelle. Following their first year together, the film captures the joy and uncertainty of chasing a shared dream while navigating pressures that could spark their breakup—or their breakthrough.

title: FKA twigs: Live at the Adidas Arena, Paris
overview: As part of her "Body High" tour - FKA twigs brings her visionary spectacle to Paris for a genre-defying show. The performance served as a culmination of all that the artist has represented to culture over the last decade. It highlighted her mastery of WuShu, opera, visual arts, vogueing, pole-dancing, and her professional background in dance, while she performed songs from her GRAMMY-award-winning album 'EUSEXUA' and her lauded discography. A towering figure in modern music, FKA twigs is celebrated for her unique perspective and her total art approach – where sound, visuals, and performance merge into a single, immersive experience. The performance unfolds within a breathtaking scenography: video projections, theatrical vignettes, and choreography, all of which have earned praise from numerous publications, including The Guardian, which has described the tour as "an Olympian display of pop prowess.

title: Inah
overview: Inah lives a solitary life with her cat, Frida. Trapped in a process of grief, she retreats into her paintings. When Daniela, Inah’s granddaughter, comes to visit, she begins to notice some unusual behaviors. Amid moments of affection, joy, and forgetfulness, Dani realizes that Frida represents more of an escape than a refuge for her grandmother.

title: O Menino Que Carregava Água na Peneira
You+Me - Against the World
overview: Alma Lancaster, 18, appears to lead a perfect life within a wealthy family who believes she is studying law. In secret, she pursues her true dream: filmmaking. On campus, she meets Vadim Arcadi, 20, a magnetic and solitary rebel with a troubled past. Forced to collaborate on a student film, they clash, grow closer and fall in love — despite themselves. But someone is watching them, determined to tear them apart and expose secrets that could destroy both Alma and Vadim.

title: Lust Stories 3
overview: Through four bite-sized yet emotionally resonant films, the anthology once again explores lust, love, relationships, and repressed desire, offering fresh perspectives on intimacy, longing, and human connection in all their complexity.

title: The Dark Heaven
overview: In the Hill Village of Mekkarai, Where It is Customary for Men to Die Every Seven Years During the Month of June, a Newly Appointed Police Inspector Arrives to Investigate a Series of Mysterious Murders. As He Digs Deeper Into the Village's Dark Secrets and Long-standing Beliefs, He Finds Himself Trapped in a Web of Crime, Fear, and Hidden Truths.

title: The Musical
overview: Doug, a frustrated playwright and middle school theater teacher, learns his ex is dating his nemesis, the school principal. To get revenge and cost him a Blue Ribbon Award, Doug secretly stages the most inappropriate play imaginable.

title: Best of the Best
overview: Two childhood besties join UCLA's competitive Bollywood-fusion dance team, only to find the road to the US championships is fiercer than they imagined.

title: Daniel and the Fiery Furnace
overview: During the Jewish exile to Babylon, Daniel and his friends face trials as Babylon's armies conquer Jerusalem. Under King Nebuchadnezzar, they gain royal favor but make enemies. Their faith is tested at the fiery furnace.

title: Morro
overview: Veterinarian Mateo lives in grief following the death of his son. When he treats the injured dog of a local crime boss, the bond he forms with the animal helps him rediscover his purpose amidst the city's simmering violence.

title: El Desocaso
overview: Once even six years, a woman performs an important family ritual.

title: Between Us
overview: Between Us is a short documentary that weaves together six intimate conversations between Quebecers and an artificial intelligence. This device becomes a playful yet unsettling space where each participant seeks listening, advice, and comfort. Between Us paints a sensitive portrait of a society longing for connection while exposing the machine’s inability to truly fulfill our interpersonal needs.

title: Rage
overview: Anbu, a taxi driver from Kannagi Nagar, meets Regina, a mute IT employee, during his regular trips and falls for her. When he learns about her troubled personal life, he suppresses his feelings. One night, Regina dies in what appears to be an accident—but soon, it’s revealed to be a planned murder. Shockingly, multiple unconnected people are involved. RAGE follows Anbu’s journey to uncover the truth behind Regina’s death and the tangled motives that led to it.

title: The History of Concrete
overview: After attending a workshop on how to write and sell a Hallmark movie, filmmaker John Wilson tries to use the same formula to sell a documentary about concrete.

title: In a Violent Nature: Part 2
overview: Johnny heads to a summer camp, where he crosses paths with a young, outcast camper who is forced to spend the night with his counselor sister and her friends at their annual end-of-season party

title: Dreamland
overview: Ever since his moth­er died in a fire, Ter­rence has seclud­ed him­self in an emo­tion­less world.  He goes through his dai­ly teenag­er life apa­thet­i­cal­ly… with one excep­tion! The sim­ple sight of a flame plunges him into a world of fear, an awak­en ver­sion of his night­mares – for, every time he falls asleep, he help­less­ly relieves the trag­ic event, thus rekin­dling his pyro­pho­bia. Until that one night he can’t bear it any­more and stops run­ning away from the dev­il­ish flames. Lit­tle does he know that, by doing so, he over­came his great­est fear and became a Trav­el­er: a very spe­cial kind of Dream­er, able to explore Dream­land, the dimen­sion born from mankind’s dreams… and nightmares!

title: Falco Mon Amour
overview: Falco is the only German-language singer to reach number one in the US billboard chart. This documentary looks back at the life and work of the 1980s Austrian cultural phenomenon who took the world by storm with hits like "Rock Me Amadeus", "Vienna Calling" and "Der Kommissar". With contributions from his last girlfriend, Caroline Perron.

title: Pacific
overview: A group of young travelers are stranded on an island in the Pacific where they struggle to escape an evil presence kept hidden from mankind for centuries.

title: Beloved
overview: Asle and Gerd met in a small coastal village far west towards the sea. They have a son, and for a time their happiness is perfect. But Asle, the sailor, is restless and is drawn to the sea, while Gerd is left in the village, alone with the child. The distance between them folds, and the question is asked: How much distance can love tolerate?

title: General Mayhem: The Killing of Brigadier J
overview: When a young officer is murdered inside a general's home, a high-stakes investigation exposes a web of corruption and a cover-up reaching the highest ranks of the National Police.

title: MAD
overview: A man struggles with the reality of family life.

title: Felt
overview: Eleven year old Ella must face her monsters when confronted with her older sister moving away.

title: Daayra
overview: Raman, who has had a shady record with staged encounters and police brutality, finds himself cornered as Ajooni challenges him on every step.

title: Queen at Sea
overview: Amanda and her stepfather Martin struggle with a moral issue that divides them. Has Amanda’s mother Leslie, who has dementia, lost the ability to make critical decisions in her own best interests? And, if so, who is responsible – a spouse, a child, an institution – for making such a determination? As Amanda and Martin are forced to make increasingly difficult choices, the repercussions spiral out of their control.

title: Zakir Khan: Papa Yaar
overview: Zakir Khan reflects on his childhood and the special bond he shares with his father, turning personal memories and family experiences into heartfelt comedy. With his signature blend of observational humour, poetry and emotional storytelling, he explores the unspoken sides of fatherhood and the relationship between a father and son.

title: Vibe
overview: Two inseparable friends' ordinary, unassuming lives spiral into an unpredictable, high-energy adventure that pushes their survival instincts and friendship to the limit.

title: Edgar Allan Poe’s Murder Mystery Dinner Party: The Musical
overview: Edgar Allan Poe is throwing a murder mystery dinner party, and you’re invited—alongside his ghostly sidekick Lenore and a room full of famous authors, all with something to hide. But as the wine flows and the fake murders become real, guests start dropping like flies. Whodunnit? Why!? And who’s next?!!  Join literary legends from Mary Shelley and Lewis Carroll to Jane Austen and Oscar Wilde as they scramble to solve the mystery, protect their secrets, and defend their outsized egos.  Based on the hit web series, this brand-new musical serves up mystery, mayhem, and original songs in one delightfully deadly night of theatre.

title: Strays
overview: Mati, a six-year-old girl, spends her last day with her foster siblings before being adopted. Guided by her protective older sister Valeria, the children sneak past the park fence and onto the train tracks, where they pass the time flattening pennies. But when Mati finds a dead cat, she insists on spending the day preparing a funeral for it.

title: Sick
overview: During the summer holidays, sixteen-year-old Maks and his older sister Emmaare sent to the Polish countryside to care for their ailing grandmother.  Trapped together in the heavy, stifling isolation of the summer heat, the siblings’ bond begins to shift into something unsettling and difficult to define. As tensions rise and boundaries begin to blur, their grandmother’s frail presence takes on an increasingly disturbing quality, turning a once-idyllic summer into a haunting passage into adulthood.

title: MANJAR
overview: A youthful Marathi family entertainer about friendship, love, family relationships and the unpredictable situations of everyday life, seen through the amusing perspective of an observant cat.

title: Embers
overview: Jasmine and Phoebe are at their breaking point. Will they keep on going or is this the end?

title: Thread Bound
overview: When a skeptical teen meets a mysterious boy with a healing gift, they begin a journey to unravel the painful threads of their past, and discover that something greater may be connecting it all.

title: The Vanishing Song
overview: Cut off from his kind, a lone gibbon calls out from a vanishing forest patch in the heart of a Malaysian city — and a team races to reach him before time runs out.

title: Pulp: What Do You Do for an Encore?
overview: A fusion of the brilliantly choreographed stage spectacle of Pulp’s biggest ever arena show — part of the global tour for More, the band’s first album in 24 years — with four decades of colorful, never-seen-before archival material.

title: Pining, Ohio
overview: A young woman struggling with grief searches for her innocence.

title: Brasifilia
overview: An essay film in which three young people unearth a clandestine archive of Brazilian cinema and plunge into a Dadaist–Third World delirium. Amid forbidden images and personal memories, they implode the very idea of Brazil.

title: Ethel
overview: Ethel Berkowitz only wants to have a quiet afternoon prepping for Halloween, but when she is interrupted by her unhinged neighbor she is forced into a tense exchange which promises to push them both to their limits.

title: Heart of the Beast
overview: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

title: Falling
overview: Alone in the suffocating quiet of his surrogate sister’s apartment, fifteen-year-old Analu clings desperately to memories of his lost loved one, Iolani, the one person who made him feel seen. The night becomes a battleground of haunting flashbacks and quiet suffering, as Analu teeters between holding on and letting go. Malu, his surrogate sister, fights to reach the part of him still holding on. Falling is a raw, intimate journey through trauma, where the weight of the past threatens to eclipse the connections that remain.

title: Killer Ants
overview: A quiet community is thrown into terror when a deadly breed of ants begins spreading without warning. Small enough to go unnoticed and dangerous enough to overwhelm anyone in their path, the insects quickly turn familiar surroundings into a deadly trap.  As the infestation grows, survival becomes a race against an enemy that can enter almost anywhere. With the threat multiplying and escape becoming increasingly difficult, those caught in its path must find a way to stop the swarm before it consumes everything around them.

title: Cegsex
overview: When a mouth erupts on Tomos's arm after trying to bypass online porn restrictions, he must muffle his sins before mum finds out.

title: Play House
overview: While renovating a dilapidated house to win back his ex, a young man discovers VHS tapes of an unaired TV show in the basement. But as the show’s dark history surfaces, it seeps into his life, threatening his last chance at reconciliation.

title: The Unrehearsed
overview: An actress prepping for a career defining audition starts to spiral as performance, identity, and reality begin to blur.

title: Dead Serious
overview: When a zombie outbreak descends upon a sleepy Midwestern town, a naive high school nerd must trek across the haunted rural wasteland in order to save his cheerleader crush from joining the undead.

title: Denial
overview: A young man struggles with Bipolar Disorder as he begins a new job and flirtation.

title: Woodzilla
overview: After years of disrespect from his students, a creepy film teacher finally snaps. Leaving none of his oblivious students safe.

title: Truth Or Dare
overview: At a seemingly normal sleepover with 5 friends, one question ends the night in horror

title: Cannibal
overview: A young woman haunted by her past is about to embark on a journey in an attempt to forget and atone for her sins, but she will end up spiraling into a nightmare of terror and tragedy that teaches her there are things one cannot escape.

title: Sidelined
overview: A couple hosts a dinner to celebrate their recent engagement. But the inclusion of a distant sibling and their partner resurfaces family grievances and proves that some things are harder to share than a last name…

title: NCT 127 5TH TOUR ‘NEO CITY  SEOUL - THE REDLINE’ in CINEMAS
overview: Back after almost two years, NCT 127's fifth tour,  NCT 127 5TH TOUR ‘NEO CITY : SEOUL - THE REDLINE’, is coming live to cinemas!  Experience the explosive energy, world-class performances, and electrifying atmosphere of KSPO DOME brought to life on the big screen with immersive sound.  NCTzens, join us for the spectacular kickoff of 'THE REDLINE'!

title: Pathetic Fallacy
overview: A young widower arrives in a new-age mountain town in search of cosmic answers and a chance to heal. Instead, he finds an outlandish murderer and a forest of demonic spirits who offer a horrific bargain: the power to cheat death at a nightmarish cost.

title: Ashes Again!
overview: Tabby and her dad are having their photograph taken, but Tabby refuses to smile: Dad doesn't even keep them - just sends them to her mum (wherever the hell she is).

title: Less of a Stranger
overview: As the leader of Polish rock band Lady Pank, Jan Borysewicz shapes a generation with his music, while a string of family tragedies shapes him.

title: Ouroboros
overview: Jacot is a silent executioner: he kills, he carries out orders, he never fails at his task. When Perrin, an overly talkative guard, brings him a child to execute, he chooses to defy the royal order and lets the child escape.  Jacot must then face the consequences of his act: if he is found out, he will be condemned himself. He will have to cover his tracks and craft a lie so perfect that Perrin will believe it.

title: Silhouettes
overview: Franco lives with a mysterious presence that visits him during his sleepless nights. An unexpected encounter with Caro, a friend from his past, challenges the refuge he finds in that figure with the possibility of reconnecting with what's real.

title: Contame otra vez
overview: Inside a vintage train-car café, a grandfather shares his past while his grandson scrolls the present away.

title: Penance
overview: While traveling through an unsafe land, a Soldier and a Princess take shelter in a seemingly empty cavern.

title: Rexach. Correr es de Cobardes
overview: The film looks back at Rexach’s more than 45-year association with FC Barcelona, from his time as a youth player and first-team footballer to his work as a coach, sporting director, scout and presidential adviser. It focuses on his role in some of the club’s defining periods, particularly his relationship with Johan Cruyff, the success of the Dream Team, and his involvement in the discovery and signing of Lionel Messi.

title: One Last Shot
overview: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defense network.

title: Masahe
overview: Alluring Zsara Laxamana takes center stage in Masahe, where she explores the sensual art of touch and the fantasies it can awaken. Discover intimate massage techniques that tease the senses, heighten desire, and turn every stroke into an unforgettable experience.

title: Todo lo que (no) nos dijimos anoche
Nimesh Patel: Buy The Dip
overview: In his first Netflix special, Nimesh Patel talks rebelling against his traditional parents and why you should never go viral in India.

title: Yowza! invalid
overview: A young woman confronts her father with a baseball bat concerning a rumor.

title: Fragmentos
overview: On the night she leaves, Natalia moves between the present and fragments of a love she once knew.

title: Four Seasons in Java
overview: Pertiwi returns to her hometown after spending two decades in prison to rebuild her life. There, she finds power in things that have been abandoned: discarded electronic devices that mysteriously light up and a community of outcasts living on the fringes of society. But coming home also means confronting the four men who sent her to prison and now rule the village. Together with the outcasts, Pertiwi begins to uncover the darkness that still haunts the place - and the past she thought she had left behind.

title: The Love Hypothesis
overview: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.

title: Primetime
overview: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history. When a high stakes operation goes fatally wrong, his veneered dream of fame curdles into a nightmare of performative justice.

title: Possible Love
overview: A laid-off worker and his wife cross paths with a documentary filmmaker and her spouse and confront their hidden desires.

title: Sense and Sensibility
overview: A charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood.

title: The Paradise
overview: In 1980s Secunderabad, a marginalized tribe battles discrimination and fights for citizenship under an unexpected leader's guidance, challenging systemic oppression.

title: The Scavenger
overview: When his aspiring-celebrity sister becomes trapped in a criminal scheme within an entertainment company, a devoted brother teams up with local police to uncover the truth and take down the powerful underworld behind it.

title: Multwoh: Patay na Patay Sa'yo
overview: When a college queer dies suddenly in their dorm, they return as a ghost — not to seek revenge, but to say the one thing they never found the courage to say in life: "I love you".

title: Tazza: The Song of Beelzebub
overview: Jang Taeyoung, who believes he has everything after building a successful online casino business, loses it all to his former best friend and namesake, Park Taeyoung. The two reunite on the international poker circuit for a high-stakes battle of revenge.

title: Cop This
overview: It's Grand Final Day and in a suburban police station about to be replaced by an AI 'Terminal', the two remaining cops (Nicolette Minster and Ray O'Leary) are tasked with babysitting a drug dealer for 24 hours.

title: Another Day
overview: Garance is a young actress, but not a star. She manages everything as best she can, valiant, cheerful, a soldier, and she finds in alcohol an unconditional fuel, a source of comfort. Garance changes her life and begins an eight-year journey of moves, work, encounters, parties and anxieties, joys and hardships… An intimate, friendly, and sexual revolution. But she consumes, more and more. Until the very possibility of death…

title: The Assassin(s)
overview: In 1974, a shooting shocks South Korea. Detective Cheol-gu, who witnesses the attack, Jae-hwan, the city desk editor whose coverage is suppressed, and Young-il, a rookie reporter, begin to dig beneath the cover-up. As their pursuit of the truth deepens, they come to confront forces meant to remain unseen.

title: Ha-Chan, Shake Your Booty!
overview: Haru and Luis love competing in Tokyo’s ballroom dance scene, but after tragedy strikes, Haru withdraws into isolation. When friends coax her back to the studio, she develops an infatuation with the new instructor. She must face what comes next as sparks fly.

title: Lines of Riga
overview: A portrait of a modern city. Documented and artistically interpreted life in Riga unfolds over a single summer day. Dynamic shifts between three main characters – a food courier, a tram driver, and a young girl – reveal the inhabitants’ daily trajectories and interactions with the city. A mosaic of intermittent scenes highlights nuances often lost in everyday routines, capturing the rhythm of the city and its rich urban life beyond the limits of the story.

title: Pinagkaisahan
overview: In a crowded public hospital, three women from different walks of life struggle against an oppressive system—each fighting for care, dignity, and the right to be seen.

title: Beast
overview: After a final harvest forced upon him by the landlord, an old farmer and his loyal carabao embark on a magical road trip to Manila, chasing the ghost of a niece the years stole from him.

title: Shish Doo
overview: Over the course of one night, two friends, Adel and Nabil, find an unconscious wealthy young man and decide to kidnap him for ransom to escape poverty and despair. As events escalate, the kidnappers’ interests become entangled with the young man’s family and a powerful man who exploits his disappearance, revealing class conflicts, power struggles, and moral collapse.

title: Red Rocks
overview: On the French Riviera, two gangs of kids compete in the perilous game of cliff jumping. Géo, barely five years old, discovers over the course of a summer a world where friendship blends with rivalry, and where the first stirrings of the heart emerge against the dazzling Mediterranean landscape.

title: The Whistler
overview: Reeling from their daughter's loss, Nicole and Sebastian come into possession of a secluded Venezuelan farm, unaware of the dark forces they're about to face.

title: Spidey and the Avengers: Halloween Team-Up!
overview: Spidey and the Avengers' Halloween plans are turned upside down by the mysterious Hallows' Eve, who plays magical tricks on trick or treaters and plans to ruin Halloween forever.

title: Charlie Harper
overview: As an ambitious chef and her struggling partner move to a new city to start fresh, the stark divide in their drives tests the limits of their love.

title: The Florist
overview: A quiet horticulturalist harboring a secret life as a lethal assassin finds his true identity jeopardized when he forms an unlikely friendship with a witnesses to police corruption.

title: The Cycle
overview: A daughter unravels her father's dark past after his body, missing for 36 years, is found at a horrific crime scene.

title: Crawlers
overview: Tenants at Paradiso Palms apartments fight a deadly spider invasion while the cunning building manager might be their only hope for survival.

title: Entre líneas
overview: A young man wanders the city, sketching urban scenes that catch his eye in his notebook. It is during this journey that he discovers what he truly wants to do.

title: A Clockwriter
overview: A screenwriter’s character manifests time, with each typewritten letter advancing the clock one minute closer to an encircling deadline.

title: Matchmaking 3
overview: The sequel to Matchmaking 2.

title: Memburu Pemangsa
overview: Following a localized string of youth abductions and homicides, a cynical newspaper editor forms a desperate alliance with a law enforcement officer and three investigative journalists to track a missing child, uncovering a malevolent force that forces them to choose between self-preservation and lethal sacrifice.

title: No Pain
overview: Davide’s life is turned upside down by a tragic event for which he bears an unwitting responsibility. Devastated by guilt, he is driven to a series of seemingly irrational choices that gradually lead him toward profound consequences. Yet, through his deep emotional bond with Elsa, Davide may still find an unexpected path to peace.

title: Ibadah & Cinta
overview: A secular young man raised in Australia undergoes a profound spiritual awakening after falling in love with the daughter of a prominent Islamic scholar, only for their matrimonial aspirations to be jeopardized by a pre-arranged betrothal mandated by her traditionalist family.

title: What Lies Between Us
overview: A quiet suburban community is shaken by the alleged sexual assault of a teenage boy by two of his peers. As the town reels, successful real estate agent Anne Sofie discovers her own son may be more involved than she imagined. Determined to protect him and the family's reputation, she makes a choice that sets her on a collision course with the other boys' mothers, Sarah and Ulrikke. As accusations against her son begin to spread, the pressure mounts and to shield her family, Anne Sofie pins the blame on one of the other boys. But as her relationships fracture and her moral compass wavers, she’s forced to make a life-altering decision.

title: El patio
overview: During naptime at their grandfather's house, Julia and Matías play in the yard until Julia throws the ball into the neighboring property—owned by Ranamacho, a mysterious man who destroys any balls that land on his land. Caught between naivety and fear, the siblings' relationship becomes strained when Matías attempts to climb the wall to retrieve it.

title: Romanovs: Loyalty and Betrayal
overview: The film tells the story of the final years of the life of Nicholas II, the last emperor of Russia. It follows his devoted wife, Empress Alexandra; his son, Tsarevich Alexei; his daughters, Grand Duchesses Olga, Tatiana, Maria, and Anastasia; and his brother, Grand Duke Michael Alexandrovich. The love and loyalty of those closest to Nicholas accompanied him through the most difficult years of his life. But they could not protect him from betrayal. The treachery and cowardice of members of the Romanov dynasty, politicians of every kind, and generals who had sworn allegiance to the throne ultimately led to the collapse of the empire. The story of the imperial family unfolds against the backdrop of a tragic turning point in history.

title: Mek in mek
overview: Facing financial trouble, an obscure singer with a talent for impersonation teams up with his friends to perform as a double of pop star Arkadi Dumikyan at private events. Chaos ensues when the real singer discovers someone else is touring under his name.

title: Power Trip
overview: A rideshare driver ends up in an unexpectedly complicated conversation with a passenger.

title: Lovebox
overview: A society without money or competition: AfrikaBurn, the largest regional event inspired by the world-famous Burning Man, becomes the setting for a unique experiment. In the middle of the South African desert, an eclectic group of friends sets up their LOVEBOX spaceship, inviting visitors on a journey to the stars — and into themselves. Inside the LOVEBOX, two strangers meet for a few minutes and explore a question about love. Their encounters give rise to unexpected moments of connection and self-discovery. When the dust of the festival settles, the friends set out to bring the magic of the LOVEBOX into everyday life. But can the openness and sense of connection they experienced at AfrikaBurn survive beyond its temporary utopia?

title: Hombre al agua
overview: Camilo, a Cuban lifeguard, saves Mexican businessman Abel from drowning. Grateful, Abel brings Camilo to Mexico, where he marries Abel's daughter, Juana, and they have a child. But Camilo soon discovers his new life is part of Abel's Machiavellian plan of manipulation and control. With his world collapsing, Camilo must uncover the plot and take control of his destiny. Will he find a way out, or remain trapped in the power game?

title: Bandkhor
overview: Six women from different backgrounds unite to challenge societal expectations. Bandkhor chronicles their journeys toward dignity and freedom as they reclaim their lives and forge their own paths through courage and determination.

title: UNABOMBER
overview: Follow Ted Kaczynski's transformation from Harvard prodigy into the infamous Unabomber. Subjected to controversial psychological experiments by Professor Henry Murray, Kaczynski's troubled past resurfaces decades later when his manhunt, led by FBI agent Joanne Miller, brings to light the chilling consequences of ambition and isolation.

title: Family
overview: A 10-year-old girl begins to believe her parents are trying to kill her. Convinced a sinister spirit is to blame, she spirals into a haunting fantasy world that mirrors her deepest fears.

title: Meesaya Murukku 2
overview: After facing rejection in love and getting into a fight, Jeeva learns about his father Siva's struggles and sacrifices. Inspired by his grandfather's legacy and father's dedication, Jeeva changes his outlook and works hard toward his musical dream. Through determination and perseverance, Jeeva earns recognition in the music industry and brings pride to his family.

title: LA BOLA NEGRA
overview: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.

title: NAZA
overview: In secret conversations on the rooftops of Tel Aviv at night, the systems behind Israel's calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza are revealed by the people who designed and operated them.

title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
overview: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him – and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

title: Premada Oorali
overview: Premada Oorali is a heartfelt love story set in picturesque villages in the 2020s. The film intertwines romance and family drama, exploring the relationships between a father and son, as well as a boy and girl, as they navigate through intriguing, yet relatable, relationship challenges.

title: The Deputy
overview: A young sheriff's deputy finds himself in the crosshairs of dangerous criminals when the dead body he is assigned to keep an eye on disappears from a crime scene.

title: Stolen Heart
overview: A shy recovering kleptomaniac risks his sobriety when his crush encourages him to help her steal an artifact from a museum.

title: Dorothy
overview: Set in a world shaped by caste, violence, and toxic masculinity, two childhood friends grow up inseparable in rural Tamil Nadu. Their lives are transformed by the arrival of Dorothy, a woman whose compassion quietly challenges the world around them.

title: Don't Be Shy!
overview: Quintessential Mean Girl, Shyamili ‘Shy’ Das, finds herself suddenly relegated to Loser-ville when Mayank, her boyfriend of three years, suddenly dumps her. But Shy, all set to get her revenge, finds herself falling into friendship and compassion with someone unexpected… Mayank’s new girlfriend - Tara.

title: Love Lottery
overview: When a young woman, Bharani Verma, is found dead under mysterious circumstances, the police quickly arrest Kartik Saxena, making him the prime suspect in a seemingly open-and-shut murder case. But as the courtroom battle begins, every testimony uncovers new questions instead of answers. Hidden relationships, conflicting statements, and buried secrets gradually transform a simple murder trial into a gripping mystery where nothing is as it appears. Beyond the suspense, the film also explores a thought-provoking question: Have marriage and legal battles become a silent punishment for some innocent men, or is the truth far more complex than it seems? With every hearing, the truth becomes more elusive, and just when the verdict seems certain, an unexpected twist changes the entire direction of the case. A taut courtroom suspense thriller that keeps the audience guessing until the very last moment.

title: Peppa Pig: Perfect Holiday
overview: When Peppa learned that her family wouldn't be going on vacation this year, she was very disappointed. However, a sudden storm transported her to faraway China! Peppa embarked on a wonderful adventure until she was reunited with her family, and Peppa had the perfect vacation ever.

title: Buzzkill
overview: A group of sorority sisters end up trapped with a murderer. Nora’s tipsy memories hold the clues to figuring out who is killing their friends, but she can only remember them when she’s drunk.

title: First Time?
overview: A boozy Friday night hangout turns sour once a scarring memory takes control.

title: The Other
overview: A short mystery horror film written and directed by filmmaker Hakeem Ahmed.  What begins as an ordinary Saturday for Salim quickly takes a disturbing turn when he notices someone is following him.  A stranger.  The same clothes.  The same places.  Always there.  An unsettling coincidence soon becomes something far more disturbing.  As the day descends into paranoia and fear, Salim is finally forced to confront the person who has been stalking him.  Some things are better left unknown.

title: Strindbergs Ensam
overview: Based on Strindberg's autobiographical book of the same name. Is it better to self isolate than to put in all the work it takes to maintain a social life?

title: Slåtter
overview: The short film premieres as part of World Affairs’ exhibition "Collected Works 2016–2026" by Jonatan Leandoer Håstad.

title: Ballroom
overview: A devastating accident forces aspiring dancer Violet to relearn life in a wheelchair. Through dance and an unexpected bond, she discovers that dreams don't disappear - they transform.

title: Attention Seeker
overview: The Powers, a picturesque family. David Powers, a classic country singer with a comeback album on the horizon works away with his tools on the grounds of the estate. Janet Powers, the matriarch of the house toiling away in the kitchen preparing a feast for the family. Ben Powers, buried amongst the various computer windows of gameplay, text chats, and live streaming feeds. And Grace, dejected with a black eye starring into old pictures of days when she thought she was happy. One click is all it would take, it wouldn't undo any of what she's been through, and yeah it would probably make it all worse, she'd be attacked by everyone, the whole family would. A single click on the 'publish' button, and everything would come out, everything about her father, what it's like to live in this house. 'Why not' she thinks, 'I won't be here to see it, burn it all down'.

title: Other Half
overview: After cheating on her girlfriend, Jade (Grace Rolek) finds herself isolated in a world of newfound heart break. Determined to suffer through the grieving process alone, she refuses to answer calls, texts or communicate with friends and family. In her booze-soaked depression, Jade attempts to rediscover what being alone really means. With no one to blame but herself, she indulges in self-destructive behavior to cope. Despite her attempts to ignore her estranged best friend Avery (Cleopatra Boudreau), Jade is surprised to find her showing up at her door and entering (well, stampeding) into her space. What unfolds is a night of reckoning and rediscovery of their friendship.

title: Hope Street: One of Our Own
overview: A violent crime committed against a much-loved local and the police investigation brings bad news for DS Marlene Pettigrew. Love is also in the air and there’s a wedding to plan, but this is Port Devine, what could possibly go wrong?

title: Us
overview: In a country marked by violence, a group of incarcerated women participates in a film workshop inside a prison in Guayaquil. As they film their daily lives, stories of love, guilt, and forced separation from their children emerge. Through games and confessions, the camera creates a space for resistance, where imagination transcends the prison’s boundaries and allows them to explore other ways of being.

title: Where the Hell Is Anna?
overview: When her estranged best friend Anna mysteriously vanishes into a women-only retreat in the woods, messy and heartbroken Derick crashes the culty pagan commune determined to bring her home. But the longer she stays, the harder it gets to tell who’s healing and who’s brainwashed. As the Summer Solstice nears and Anna is chosen for a “ceremony” called Induction Day, Derick uncovers disturbing secrets buried beneath the flower crowns and sisterhood mantras, including blood rituals, fertility experiments, and the looming promise of paradise known as Summerland.

title: The Patrick Star Show: Week of Stars!
overview: A Mini-Series from the fifth season of The Patrick Star Show containing the episodes "Gone Bootin'," Roller Bunny," "Squ-AD-ina," "Don't Friend the Reaper." and "Pat Alone... At Home"

title: Cascarrabias
overview: When Chava returns home to care for his ailing father, bitter truths lead them to a point of no return.

title: The Journey of Heroes
overview: The Journey of Heroes follows Ny (Steven Nguyễn), who, after rescuing his younger sister from a human trafficking ring along the Western border, is captured alongside his best friend and forced into slavery inside a brutal scam compound. There, together with undercover investigators and fellow victims suffering in silence, they secretly devise a daring plan to escape.

title: The Stunt Driver
overview: Based on the true story of Montrealer Ken Carter, the “Mad Canadian” stunt driver who tried to jump the Saint Lawrence River in a rocket car in the mid-’70s. Carter's dream was to end his 30-year career with a big jump, a big paycheck, and mega stardom. In the process of accomplishing it, he hired a big sports manager and enlisted the best in rocket car design, with the National Film Board of Canada filming a documentary leading up to the event.

title: Mission D.D.L.J.
overview: Diya dreams of a fairy tale love story like Dilwale Dulhaniya Le Jayenge & Dhrubo doesn’t belive in classic love. Eventually life brings them to a point, where they both have to come together & follow the paths.

title: Invention 13
overview: On a cold, windy night, a frustrated pianist encounters strange obstacles while trying to learn  Bach's notoriously intricate Invention 13.

title: Ang Paroroonan
overview: A store where the lost, the searching, the waiting, and those headed toward a destination come to a stop.

title: Burdened
overview: After a tragic car crash leaves their mother in a coma, 19-year-old Dakota is forced into adulthood as she becomes the primary caregiver for her younger brother, Zach, a young boy struggling with severe ADHD. Torn between grief, guilt, and her own stalled future, she must decide how much of herself she can give without disappearing.

title: Wingclipper
overview: Stardust, a young wife and mother, suffocates in the perfect, yet male-centric Funcyland. Through reveries, she is led to extreme actions in search of her true self, outside her golden cage.

title: Koplopers
overview: When five football hooligans from the south of the Netherlands take part in a social experiment, a confrontational group game exposes hidden vulnerabilities and challenges their loyalty, leading the group to unravel.

title: AEW All Out 2026
overview: The 2026 All Out was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on September 26, 2026, at the NOW Arena in Hoffman Estates, Illinois, USA. The show was headlined by an AEW World Title match between current Champion Will Ospreay and challenger Jon Moxley.

title: Perfect Princess
overview: Reluctantly donning princess regalia and delivering cupcakes, Chad stumbles through an ill-fated day - only to discover that leaving with nothing might be pretty sweet.

title: Metamorphosis
overview: For their graduation project, Lisa spends two weeks living in a terrarium. As her behavior changes more and more, her classmate Victor must decide how far he is willing to go for the sake of their art.

title: False Lucidity
overview: A troubled young woman uses her ability to lucid dream to escape her reality and buried trauma that eventually manifest and drag her through a series of nightmares.

title: Gebroken hart
overview: While her schoolfriends look forward to adulthood, eighteen-year-old Tasnim struggles with the consequences of her donor heart, which means hospital visits between exams, and sometimes having to scale back her dreams for the future.

title: Children of the Sun
overview: Four friends from Berlin spend their summer in Greece trying to free themselves of all societal norms and conventions. They throw away their phones, open their relationships and begin to question all mental and physical limits in search of freedom. But just as their newfound utopia unfolds, forest fires erupt around their camp. The four friends realize that they might have to leave the country and above all, their youthful ideals behind.

title: Growth
overview: "Growth" is a hilarious documentary about cancer. No, really. "Growth" explores the healing power of laughter and asks, "How do you joke about cancer? CAN you joke about cancer? And WHY should you joke about cancer?"

title: Erva
overview: Someone is living in Erva's house... Wandering around, eating her food from the fridge, rearranging her belongings, and even sleeping in her bed while she's away.

title: Il mio nome è Carlo
overview: The movie traces three key moments: the six-year-old boy, already driven by an extraordinary spiritual sensitivity; the eleven-year-old boy, curious and brilliant; and the fifteen-year-old in his first year of high school, self-aware and determined, capable of approaching everyday life with an extraordinary outlook.

title: RW-LO
overview: Martine Syms blends recreations with home movies from the life of Brent David Freaney, a lifelong pop girlie who was once, as vintage camcorder footage reveals, a Deep South teenager obsessed with outspoken The Real World: New Orleans castmate Melissa Howard. RW-LO is a nostalgic—and surprising—inquiry into what happens when people start being celebrities, and they stop being real.

title: Sundown
overview: Joakim, a young, compassionate caregiver working in a dementia Ward, navigates the emotional toll of his work as he learns to accept the limits of his ability to help.

title: No One Leaves
overview: When Meredith and her husband go to have dinner with their neighbor on the next farm over, he introduces them to his visiting niece. But as the evening progresses, Meredith begins to suspect that this young woman isn't his niece, but his captive.

title: Partners
overview: Engaged couple Faye and Peter reunite with old friends one hot Southern night; however, when secrets are uncovered, the status quo of their "straight" relationship is thrown into question.

title: Mrs Dogfire
overview: An homage to Mrs Doubtfire in which a man dresses as a dog to unite a family.

title: Good Pasture
overview: On the night of a terrible storm, a lonely priest is visited in his church by a mysterious visitor.

title: Digger
overview: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.

title: BOMBAY STORIES
overview: Adapted from the short stories of Pakistani writer Saadat Hasan Manto, the film interweaves the lives of three sex workers and their pimps.

title: Sales Assistant
overview: On a sales day, a 28-year-old Latina migrant works at a fast fashion store in the Netherlands, surviving a job she cannot afford to lose as her body starts to resist.

title: Death Whisperer: Saming the Werebeast
overview: Follows the search for a missing military officer in the jungle of Khao Khwang, where legend says man-eating tiger spirit Saming takes human form in 1960s Thailand.

title: DEQ
overview: "DEQ" is a legacy in Kurdish Culture. A bridge between Human and Nature and a way to find meaning of life.

title: La jangada
overview: La Jangada is the union of 35 musicians embraced by nature with a common goal: to bring to life songs that are born from the heart of this country.  In search of the vastness that these songs convey, we wanted to bring a piece of Santiago del Estero's land straight to the Río de La Plata.

title: The Nice Ones
overview: When Kate joins her boyfriend’s friends at a remote countryside retreat, old wounds resurface as strange lights appear in the sky. As unease grows, members of the group begin to change—becoming unnervingly calm, kind, and “nice.” Dismissed as unstable, Kate struggles to convince the others something is wrong before the force behind it spreads.

title: Ghost Light
overview: Actress Marion Neal finds herself mired in a lawsuit over the rights to her playhouse. As strange occurrences begin to take place, the hidden truth emerges regarding an intricate web of interwoven conspiracies and villainous agendas.

title: The Swan: Behind the Mirror
overview: A look at the controversial 2004 reality series The Swan, which took self-proclaimed 'ugly ducklings' and set out to make them... not that.

title: Farewell
overview: A short film for NOTODO Film Fest.  In 1936, a man tries to flee his home in secret. But his daughter crosses his path before he can step through the doorway.

title: Scammed
overview: Millions of Americans have fallen victim to a growing epidemic of online scams, from sextortion schemes aimed at teens to crypto investment scams targeting seniors.  FRONTLINE and Associated Press have spent more than a year investigating this shadowy world that's grown into a global criminal industry, powered in many cases by organized crime, trafficked labor, American technology, and, increasingly, Al.

title: Love - Love
overview: LOVE - LOVE is the story of two brothers : Andy, who suffers from schizophrenia, and Jeff, an actor in search of success and meaning in his life. After the death of their grandmother, Andy is left without a « caretaker ». Refusing to live in a group home, he insists on moving in with their father, Bruce, whom they lost touch with after he fled his responsibilities. The two brothers then set out on a road trip to find their father, a disgraced former professional tennis player, now living in seclusion near the Salton Sea, in the California desert.

title: How Much Time
overview: During the Christmas season, six 29-year-old friends reunite at the funeral of a former schoolmate, almost ten years after they last saw each other. As they confront their unresolved lives, doubts and fears, their reunion becomes a portrait of a generation caught between the end of youth and an uncertain future.

title: gala
overview: a group of people, all united by the same love. we are family for a night. we smile, we take care of each other. jumping, punching, spitting and bleeding. moshing.

title: The Christmas Heartbeat
overview: Following sudden cardiac arrest, Julia Winters is forced back to her Nashville hometown, where Christmas never fades and old wounds still linger. To truly move forward, she must confront the past she thought she’d left behind—and the future she never saw coming.

title: Mistletoe Massacre
overview: Marion Callevero has her guest list checked twice to host the company Christmas event, but gifts quickly turn to gore. This struggling staff has been invited to the party but no one will be returning home for the holidays.

title: Verity
overview: Lowen Ashleigh is hired by Jeremy Crawford to ghostwrite novels for his bestselling author wife Verity, who is unable to finish following an accident. Lowen gradually uncovers Verity's disturbing truths while residing at the Crawfords' home to work.

title: Livestream from Hell
overview: When Kevin Hart teams up with fellow comedian, Druski, and streamer, Kai Cenat for a record-breaking livestream at his tech-savvy mansion, things go hilariously off the rails, until the pranks turn to panic, and a real murder mystery unfolds on camera, trapping the trio and their celebrity guests in a high-stakes, horror-comedy whodunnit watched by millions.

title: The Widower: 'Til Death Do Us Part
overview: A journalist and a detective uncover the truth about a killer whose charm masked a trail of failed marriages and suspicious deaths.

title: Drury Lane
overview: A flat tire leaves realtor James stranded on the side of the road. He’s now at the mercy of a stranger who finds himself on the same road, on the same night, at the same time…

title: Reawakened Man
overview: Despite unwavering support from his best friend Young-ha and the unwavering support of his younger sister Ye-rin, job seeker Seok Hwan just can't seem to land a job, repeatedly failing interviews. One night, after yet another disastrous interview, he returns home only to be attacked by a group of strangers and killed. But 72 hours after his death, Seok Hwan suddenly opens his eyes as if nothing happened. He soon discovers that he possesses a special ability: no matter how many times he dies, he comes back to life. But there's little time to process his extraordinary new power before a mysterious figure known as Black, who has discovered Hwan's existence, begins hunting him down.  Yet with each resurrection, Seok Hwan grows stronger, unleashing powers beyond anything he could have imagined!

title: WWE/AAA Worlds Collide 2026: Chicago
overview: The 2026 Worlds Collide, also promoted as Worlds Collide: Chicago, was a professional wrestling live event co-produced by WWE and its sister promotion AAA. It was the sixth Worlds Collide under the WWE banner and the third between both promotions. It was filmed on September 26, 2026, at Allstate Arena in Rosemont, Illinois, USA, but aired on September 30.

title: Atomic Eve
overview: In the year 2029, the world is at war. As announcements of incoming nuclear attack shake the United States, people of all walks of life scramble to reconcile with the end of the world.

title: LINKIN PARK: UNSHATTER
overview: After a seven-year hiatus following the devastating loss of their beloved bandmate Chester Bennington, LINKIN PARK'S remaining members struggled to find their way forward. Their shared history and enduring friendship, combined with the fresh perspective of two new band members Emily Armstrong and Colin Brittain spark a renewed creative energy that leads them on a transformative journey of artistic reinvention. Following the band from intimate 2022 studio sessions through their explosive FROM ZERO album release and concert in São Paulo, this documentary weaves together rare vault footage, electrifying performances from sold-out shows, and candid interviews with band members and fans—capturing the raw, honest story of what it means to start over.

title: Always Yours, Never Mine
overview: Across thirty years, several almosts, and timing that is never quite right, two people keep crossing paths – always on the verge of being together, but never quite making it.

title: Bitter Sweet
overview: After two girl's friendship falls apart days before Christmas, one of the girls decides to rekindle their friendship through the sweetest gift.

title: A Man of His Time
overview: September 1940. Henri Marre arrives alone in Vichy as the authoritarian regime settles in. Broke, estranged from his family, and carrying copies of his self-published manifesto Notre Salut (Our Salvation), the 49-year-old is determined to secure what he believes is his rightful place in the new administration. In his writing, Henri sets out his patriotic convictions and his engineer’s methodology: efficiency above all. Claiming he wants to help save France after defeat, he does whatever is required to remain useful, serving the machinery of the new order with increasing skill. But he may be pursuing something more urgent: escape from his own ruin

title: MORPHISM
overview: Eleven-year-old Kaat visits the Stavros family for the first time; a peculiar family of scientists where everyone, including the dog, suffers from a horrible wasp allergy. Blown away by the family, Kaat pushes her own boundaries further and further as an experimental subject.

title: The Doll
overview: Wealthy merchant Stanislaw Wokulski falls tragically in love with beautiful yet vain Izabela Lecka. His unfulfilled love leads to many foolish decisions sealing his fate.

title: One Night at KitKat
overview: Berlin, Saturday night. Behind the doors of the legendary KitKatClub, a world unfolds that usually remains hidden. In a place where mobile phones are strictly forbidden, a camera was allowed inside. The founding duo looks back on the origins of the club—a venue that, like few others, epitomizes Berlin’s club culture, techno, the fetish scene, and sex-positive parties. Guests and staff share stories of self-acceptance, body positivity, and community. Intimate, unfiltered, and non-judgmental, the documentary offers an exclusive glimpse into a night at the KitKat.

title: It's How It Ends
overview: After being expelled from college, Owen returns home to disappointed parents and leaves in the middle of the night with his younger sister Mara, wandering the city and stumbling into unexpected encounters.

title: Where to Find Foxes
overview: A new mother, kept awake by the sound of foxes prowling outside her home, ventures into the night to scare them off only to find herself a part of a strange and feral ritual.

title: Escape at Alcatraz
overview: When a covert black-ops contractor seizes Alcatraz, the CIA smuggles hardened agent Lt. Jack Callahan inside to extract whistleblower Anya Turner and her damning evidence before the mission spirals into a deadly fight for survival.
